articles.image_title: Fußball-WM: TOPSHOT - People sit near the Brooklyn Bridge as wildfire smoke from Canada causes hazy conditions on July 16, 2026 in New York. Out-of-control wildfires were raging Thursday in the Canadian province of Ontario, prompting evacuations and sending dangerous smoke billowing into the United States where millions of people were exposed to the unhealthy air. US states near the Canadian border including Minnesota, Wisconsin, Michigan and Illinois were particularly choked, as forecasters predicted the Northeast including New York would also see air quality continue to deteriorate. articles.title: Z+ (abopflichtiger Inhalt); Lionel Messi und Lamine Yamal: »Messi war völlig perplex. Ich glaube sogar ein bisschen erschrocken«
articles.teaser: Und Lamine Yamal, das Baby, war ganz ruhig. Joan Monfort hat die beiden vor 19 Jahren fotografiert. Hier erzählt er, wie es zu dem legendären Foto kam.
articles.image_title: Lionel Messi und Lamine Yamal: Interview with photographer Joan Monfort about the picture of Lamine Yamal and Messi 10.7.2024 00:00:00 Alejandro Garcia Description epa11472228 Photographer Joan Monfort pictured at his home in Barcelona, Spain, 10 July 2024. In 2007 Monfort took pictures of Barcelona players with children and their families for a charity calendar. Some of these photos showed Argentinian player and then 20-year old Barcelona forwar Lionel Messi holding Lamine Yamal who was back then just a few months old. On 09 July 2024 Lamine Yamal, now under contract at Barcelona, became the youngest player ever to score at a European Soccer Championship when Spain beat France in the semi final of the UEFA EURO 2024. EPA/Alejandro Garcia
